ayahs.1: Qāf. By the glorious Qur'an—Allah swears by His own revelation that what follows about resurrection and reckoning is among the weightiest truths you will hear.
ayahs.2: Yet those who deny are astonished that a warner from among themselves has come warning of resurrection. They say: This is something unbelievable!
ayahs.3: When we are dead and turned to dust—will we be brought back? Such a return seems impossible to them.
ayahs.4: We know exactly what the earth consumes of them after death. With Us is a preserved Record that nothing escapes.
ayahs.5: Rather, they rejected the truth when it reached them, and so they are in a confused, unstable state.
ayahs.6: Have they not looked at the sky above them—how We built it and adorned it with stars, leaving no flaw in it?
ayahs.7: And the earth: We spread it out, set upon it firm mountains, and caused every delightful kind of plant to grow from it—
ayahs.8: as an insight and reminder for every servant who turns back to Allah in repentance.
ayahs.9: We send down blessed rain from the sky and bring forth gardens and grain for harvest,
ayahs.10: and tall date palms with layered clusters of fruit,
ayahs.11: as provision for Our servants. With this rain We revive a dead land. The same power will bring you out of your graves.
ayahs.12: Before them, the people of Noah denied the truth, as did the people of the Well, Thamud,
ayahs.14: the people of the Forest, and the people of Tubba'. Each rejected their messenger, and My warning was fulfilled against them.
ayahs.15: Were We worn out by the first creation? No—they are in doubt about a new creation.
ayahs.16: We created humanity and know what their souls whisper to them. We are closer to them than their jugular vein.
ayahs.17: As the two recording angels sit—one on the right and one on the left—writing everything down,
ayahs.18: not a word does a person utter without a vigilant observer present to record it.
ayahs.19: The throes of death will bring the truth that you kept trying to escape.
ayahs.20: The Trumpet will be blown. That is the Day you were warned about.
ayahs.21: Each soul will come with a driver and a witness.
ayahs.22: You were heedless of this before. Today We have removed your veil, and your sight is sharp.
ayahs.23: One's companion angel will say: Here is the record ready with me.
ayahs.24: It will be said: Throw into Hell every stubborn denier,
ayahs.25: withholder of good, aggressor, and doubter,
ayahs.26: who set up another god with Allah. Cast them into the severe punishment.
ayahs.27: One's devilish companion will say: Our Rabb, I did not make them transgress. They were already far astray on their own.
ayahs.28: Allah will say: Do not dispute before Me. I had already warned you.
ayahs.29: My Word is not changed, and I am never unjust to My creation.
ayahs.30: On the Day We ask Hell, 'Are you full?' it will answer, 'Are there any more?'
ayahs.31: Paradise will be brought near to the righteous—not far away.
ayahs.32: This is what you were promised—for everyone who constantly turned back to Allah and kept His limits,
ayahs.33: who stood in awe of the Rahman though they could not see Him, and came with a heart turning only to Him.
ayahs.34: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting life.
ayahs.35: There they will have whatever they desire, and with Us is even more.
ayahs.36: How many communities We destroyed before them who were mightier in strength! When the punishment came, they fled across the land. Was there any escape?
ayahs.37: In this is a reminder for whoever has a mindful heart and listens attentively.
ayahs.38: We created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, and no fatigue touched Us.
ayahs.39: So endure with sabr what they say. Glorify your Rabb before sunrise and before sunset,
ayahs.40: and glorify Him during part of the night and after prostration in salah.
ayahs.41: Listen: On the Day the caller will call from a place near at hand,
ayahs.42: the Day all will hear the mighty Blast in truth—that will be the Day of coming out from the graves.
ayahs.43: It is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the final return.
ayahs.44: On the Day the earth splits open and they rush out—that gathering is easy for Us.
ayahs.45: We know best what they say. You are not sent to force them. Remind with the Qur'an those who fear My warning.
